_schema.kind: command (a command or one of its aliases), flag (one command's flag) or key (a profile key).
_schema.name: the command or alias, the flag (--old), or the key, as written in the profile.
_schema.command: flag only: the command that reads it.
_schema.table: key only: the profile table it sits in, as in [deck].
_schema.since: the version whose release first warns about it.
_schema.remove: the version that drops it: the minor after the first stable (main) minor that carried the warning. tests/deprecations-check.py fails once VERSION reaches it.
_schema.use: what to do instead, one line: the warning ends with it.

deprecated.name: notifier
deprecated.use: the tab mark (<TAB> ●N) and [push], which every notice already gets (phosphor migrate drops the line)

deprecated.name: notify_seconds
deprecated.use: nothing, it only timed notifier's floating notice (phosphor migrate drops the line)

deprecated.name: pulse
deprecated.use: phosphor fleet (the same load, per host, with history)
